facts.text: Dr. Uriah agreed, at Father William's request, to give penance at Brandon's Barrow Mound.
facts.classification: {"commitment_type":"personal_promise","stake_basis":"Father William specifically asked for this penance and Uriah agreed, but play shows no concrete need of William's that depends on it beyond his preference.","stake":"low","burden":"minor","consequence":"minor"}

facts.text: Dr. Uriah agreed to donate 10 gold to Father William for the Barrow Mound's upkeep; no payment has been made.
